leaving.title: Return your NY plates, then cancel NY car insurance
leaving.detail: In that order, and only after the car is registered in your new state. Canceling insurance first gets your NY registration suspended and can affect your license.

leaving.title: Get your NY security deposit back
leaving.detail: New York landlords must return the deposit, or send an itemized list of deductions, within 14 days of move-out.

leaving.title: File a New York part-year resident return (IT-203)
leaving.detail: If you lived in New York City, it also covers city tax for the months you lived there.
